name: island-verge-ground-check
js: (()=>{document.body.classList.add('film');const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,T=C.THREE,meshes=[];a.scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);a.scene.getObjectByName('CityGround').traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&!/Water|Lake|Streams|Walls|Bridge|Flyover/.test(o.name))meshes.push(o)});if(!meshes.length)throw Error('No rendered lawns');const ray=new T.Raycaster(),down=new T.Vector3(0,-1,0);let count=0,maxError=0;for(let x=900;x<1800;x+=7)for(let z=1700;z<2600;z+=7){const s=C.islandVergeSurfaceAt?.(x,z);if(!s)continue;ray.set(new T.Vector3(x,2,z),down);const hit=ray.intersectObjects(meshes,false)[0];if(!hit)throw Error('No ramp mesh at '+x+','+z);const ground=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person',s.h);const error=Math.max(Math.abs(hit.point.y-s.h),Math.abs(ground-s.h));maxError=Math.max(error,maxError);if(error>.003)throw Error('Ramp mismatch '+JSON.stringify({x,z,s,rendered:hit.point.y,ground,error}));count++;}if(count<100)throw Error('Too few ramp samples '+count);console.log('[island-verge-ground] '+JSON.stringify({count,maxError,stats:C.islandVergeRampStats()}));return{count,maxError};})()
